text:
Ivy (Sales): Warm handoff for NovaEdge pilot (6 months, 3 reserved GPUs). Signed last night. Primary asks: EU data residency, HIPAA controls, SFTP ingestion of parquet batches (~250GB), and a short perf baseline for 1024-token chat. Renewal looks ~9 months after pilot start. @Carlos can you take onboarding & enablement?

Carlos (CS): On it. I'll schedule kickoff and compile a checklist. Need SFTP host + creds (or a staging dump), and the compliance contact for HIPAA paperwork. Also confirm if they want Private (VPC) or Managed with EU tenancy.

Ivy (Sales): Contact for infra: vera@novaedge.ai. They prefer Private deployment in eu-west-1; company legal asked about KMS/HSM options and audit logs. SFTP endpoint: sftp.novaedge.ai (they'll provide creds in the kickoff).

Omar (Support): I'll open a ticket to track ingestion repro and SFTP transfer patterns. Large parquet batches can trigger memory pressure in the ingestion workers. Please have them provide a representative file and transfer logs.

Pri (Eng): If they're transferring parquet via SFTP, we should recommend chunked streaming and multipart uploads to object store instead of pushing whole files into the app. Also want a sample parquet (schema + row count) to estimate index build time. KV cache probably not the bottleneck here; index builder & vectorizer will be.

Ava (Product): Noted product asks: HSM/KMS integration for Private, EU tenancy SLA, and an audit-logs retention option. Logged as FR-210 (HSM) and FR-211 (audit retention). Will prioritize FR-210 as HIPAA-sensitive.

Carlos (CS): Proposed owners & next steps:
1) Kickoff + calendar invite (Carlos)
2) SFTP creds + sample parquet (Ivy -> Vera)
3) Support ticket SUP-5012 + diag bundle (Omar)
4) Eng perf estimate for 1024 tokens + index build time (Pri)
5) Compliance intake for HIPAA & KMS (Lena/Ava)
6) Enablement session + best-practices doc for SFTP -> object store flow (Carlos)
I'll propose Tue 3pm CET for kickoff unless that conflicts.

Omar (Support): Created SUP-5012 and requested sample file + transfer logs. Asked NovaEdge to run a small transfer with `scp -P 2222 sample.parquet sftp://ingest-stage/` and paste the timestamps. I've provided an upload location: s3://redwood-uploads/novaedge/diag-1998765432.tar.gz.

Pri (Eng): Quick note from a perf standpoint: 1024-token chat baseline depends heavily on the model selection + batching. For our reference cluster, typical p99 is ~480ms for FP16 7B at 512 tokens; 1024 tokens could be ~1.6x depending on beam and sampling. I'll run two bench configs (fp16, int8) once we have a sample row profile. Also will estimate index build time for 250GB parquet (rough initial guess: 4-8 hours on 4 GPUs, depends on embedding model).

Ivy (Sales): They also asked for cost projections for pilot (monthly committed) and an optional Private deployment uplift. I'll collect billing expectations and share with Carlos.

Lena (CS Manager): For renewal playbook: capture HIPAA compliance as a must-win deliverable, schedule a compliance workshop in week 2 of pilot, and plan an executive QBR at week 8. Classify initial risk as medium until compliance attestation is satisfied.

Ava (Product): Echoing FR entries. Also requesting a small design doc from Eng on KMS/HSM integration complexity and estimated ETA. Pri, can you draft a short note after initial triage?

Pri (Eng): Yes, will post a short design note outlining KMS options (customer-managed KMS in cloud vs HSM appliance) and rough ETA after I review their security contact's requirements.

deploy-bot: Provisioned env: private/novaedge-pilot-eu at 1998765530

Carlos (CS): Thanks. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. After kickoff I'll post meeting notes, an onboarding checklist, and the enablement deck. Please drop any artifacts (creds, sample files, ticket links) here so I can attach to the playbook.

Ivy (Sales): I'll follow up with Vera for SFTP credentials and their security questionnaire. Ping me if the Tue 3pm CET slot needs adjusting. :thumbsup:

Omar (Support): I'll paste SUP-5012 updates and any repro findings in this thread.

Pri (Eng): If they want a quick how-to for chunked uploads, I'll include a one-page snippet with `aws s3 cp --expected-size` examples and a short python example for streaming parquet to our object store.

Carlos (CS): Great. Action owners noted. I'll send the invite and tag folks for required artifacts.
